如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    新书！求许紫烟刚站稳身形，而且那少女的修为明显高过她，许紫烟根本躲闪不及，而且也没有什么打仗经验，愣愣地站在那里，眼看着那一耳光就要抽在自己的脸上。那少年突然前踏一步，伸手扣住了少女的手腕，向后一带，将那个少女拉了回来。微笑着对许紫烟说道：
“算了，喜妹。”
说完，放开了握着少女手腕的手，踏步而去。那少女狠狠地瞪了一眼许紫烟，刚要举步，却见一个十二三岁的少年撞到了她的身上，然后疾步向前跑去。
“找死！”
那少女一腔愤怒发泄在那个少年的身上，抬起一脚，踹在那个少年的屁股上，把那个少年被一脚踹得趴在了地上。那少年翻身也不搭言，低着头跑了开去。
这一脚似乎消了心中的怨气，那少女不再看许紫烟，径直向着前面的那个麟哥哥追去。
许紫烟摇了摇头，也无意生事，而且也没有生事的资格。重新整理一下心情，鼓足了勇气又开始一家一家地店铺看去，希望能够买到便宜的炼丹和制符的材料。
东一头西一头地瞎转，许紫烟又走进了一家店。刚一脚迈进去，便听到一个带着哭腔的惊喜：
“是你！你还敢到这里来？四叔，就是她偷去了我身上的符！”
许紫烟听了一惊，抬头一看，心中便是一怒。伸着手指朝着自己喊叫的正是那个要扇自己耳光的少女，此时脸上还挂着泪痕，而那个被她称作麟哥哥少年却不在此处。
“四叔，就是她，就是她偷走了我身上的符！”
那个叫四叔的中年汉子，目光怀疑地上下审视着许紫烟，许紫烟一头雾水地望着那个女孩，可是当她听说那女孩说她偷了她的东西的时候，登时气得满脸通红，大声喝斥道：
“你胡说，你有什么东西值得我偷的？”
“你偷了我的符！”那个少女气呼呼地说道。
“喜妹，住口！”那个四叔喝斥了一句，转头严肃地看着许紫烟，语气有些放缓地说道：“这位小姐，你可是有什么解释？”
“解释？我为什么要解释？”许紫烟委屈得眼睛里含着泪水，气愤地说道。
“四叔，她这是做贼心虚。”那个女孩咬牙切齿地说道。
“我做什么贼了？我什么时候偷你的东西了？我偷你什么东西了？”
许紫烟初到中都城，一切还很陌生，又走了一天也没有找到自己的需要的东西，可谓身心具疲，如今又受到别人的诬陷，所受的委屈可想而知，只是倔强地忍着眼中的泪水，不使它掉落下来。
“是你和一个十二三岁的小贼，你故意撞到我麟哥哥的身上，然后那个小贼趁机撞向我，偷走了我给四叔送来的符，呜呜……”说着说着，那个女孩反倒先哭起来。

她如此一说，许紫烟立刻想起了是有一个十二三岁的小孩撞了她一下，还被她踢了一个跟头，想是那个小孩偷走了她的符。想到这里，许紫烟的心里一阵解气，嘴角便掠过一丝嘲笑。那个四叔一直在注视着许紫烟脸上的神色，看到她神色的变化，心里便有九分肯定许紫烟与此事无关，不过转头看着喜妹痛苦慌张的神色，心中便有些不忍，知道她丢了那么多的符，家族是一定不会放过她的，而自己和她的父亲又十分地交好。不禁在心中暗叹了一声。心道，只好将这件事情扣在面前的这个女孩身上了，虽然如此一来，这个女孩必死无疑，但是死别人总比死自己家族的人好。再说看她的打扮也不是一个有背景的人，修为也不过是炼气期一层，死了也就死了。想到这里，便沉下了脸，冷冷地说道：
“这位小姐，你最好有个解释，否则我只好把你带到家族的刑堂了。”
“到哪里去，我也没有偷。”许紫烟的心已经沉了下去，凭着她的阅历，她已经看出来眼前的这个四叔是准备把这件事情扣在她的头上了，但是她却不能够动手，凭着她目前的修为，动手的话，一定会死得更快。
“好！”四叔的眼神中一片冰寒，淡淡地说道：“来人，把她给我绑起来。”
立刻从旁边冲出两个人，将许紫烟的双手反绑在身后。许紫烟不是没有想过反抗，可是那对面的四叔猛然释放了气势，将许紫烟紧紧地压制住，根本不能够移动分毫。
正气愤间，只见那喜妹猛地窜到自己的身前，一个耳光抽在自己的脸上，恶狠狠地骂道：

Xu Ziyan had just stood up, and the girl's cultivation was obviously higher than hers. Xu Ziyan couldn't dodge at all, and she had no fighting experience. She stood there blankly, watching the slap on her face. The young man suddenly took a step forward, reached out and grabbed the girl's wrist, and pulled the girl back. Smiling and said to Xu Ziyan:
"Forget it, Ximei."
After saying that, he let go of the hand holding the girl's wrist and stepped away. The girl glared at Xu Ziyan fiercely, and just as she was about to take a step, she saw a boy of twelve or thirteen years old bump into her, and then ran forward quickly.
"Seeking death!"
The girl vented her anger on the boy, raised her foot and kicked the boy on the butt, causing the boy to fall to the ground. The young man turned over and ran away without saying a word, lowering his head.
This kick seemed to dispel the resentment in her heart. The girl no longer looked at Xu Ziyan and chased directly towards the brother Lin in front.
Xu Ziyan shook his head and had no intention of causing trouble, and he was not qualified to cause trouble. After reorganizing my mood, I mustered up the courage and started looking at the shops one by one, hoping to buy cheap materials for alchemy and talisman making.
After wandering around in this direction, Xu Ziyan walked into another store. As soon as I stepped in, I heard a crying surprise:
"It's you! How dare you come here? Fourth uncle, it was she who stole the talisman from me!"
Xu Ziyan was shocked when he heard it. When he looked up, he felt angry in his heart. The girl who was shouting at her with her fingers outstretched was the girl who was about to slap her. There were still tears on her face, but the boy she called Brother Lin was not here.
"Fourth Uncle, it's her, she stole the talisman from me!"
The middle-aged man named Fourth Uncle looked suspiciously at Xu Ziyan up and down. Xu Ziyan looked at the girl confused, but when she heard that the girl said that she had stolen her things, she immediately flushed with anger and yelled:
"You're talking nonsense. What do you have that I can steal?"
"You stole my charm!" the girl said angrily.
"Ximei, shut up!" The fourth uncle scolded, turned to look at Xu Ziyan seriously, and said in a slow tone: "Miss, what explanation do you have?"
"Explain? Why should I explain?" Xu Ziyan said angrily with tears in her eyes.
"Uncle Fourth, she has a guilty conscience." The girl said through gritted teeth.
"What kind of thief did I become? When did I steal your things? What did I steal from you?"
When Xu Ziyan first arrived in Zhongdu City, everything was still unfamiliar. He walked for another day without finding what he needed. He was physically and mentally exhausted. Now he was framed by others. The grievances he suffered can be imagined. He just stubbornly held back the tears in his eyes and prevented them from falling.
"It was you and a little thief who was twelve or thirteen years old. You bumped into my brother Lin on purpose. Then the little thief took the opportunity to bump into me and stole the talisman I gave to my fourth uncle. Wuwu..." As he spoke, the girl started to cry first.
When she said this, Xu Ziyan immediately remembered that a child of twelve or thirteen years old bumped into her and was kicked by her. She thought that the child had stolen her talisman. Thinking of this, Xu Ziyan felt relieved, and a trace of ridicule flashed across the corner of his mouth. The fourth uncle had been watching the expression on Xu Ziyan's face. When he saw the change in her expression, he was very sure that Xu Ziyan had nothing to do with the matter. However, when he turned to look at Ximei's painful and panicked expression, he felt a little unbearable. Knowing that she had lost so many talismans, the family would definitely not let her go, and he and her father were very good friends. I couldn't help but sigh secretly in my heart. He thought to himself that he had no choice but to pin this matter on the girl in front of him. Although this girl would undoubtedly die, it was better to die to someone else than to die to a member of his own family. Besides, judging from her appearance, she does not appear to be a person with a background, and her cultivation level is only at the first level of the Qi Refining Stage. If she dies, she will die. Thinking of this, he darkened his face and said coldly:
"Miss, you better have an explanation, otherwise I will have to take you to the family execution hall."
"No matter where I go, I didn't steal it." Xu Ziyan's heart has sunk. Based on her experience, she has already seen that the fourth uncle in front of her is ready to put this matter on her head, but she cannot do it. With her current cultivation, if she does it, she will die faster.
"Okay!" Fourth uncle's eyes were cold and he said calmly: "Come here, tie her up for me."
Two people immediately rushed out from the side and tied Xu Ziyan's hands behind his back. Xu Ziyan didn't think about resisting, but the fourth uncle on the opposite side suddenly released his momentum and suppressed Xu Ziyan tightly, unable to move at all.
When he was angry, he saw that Ximei suddenly rushed in front of him, slapped him on the face, and cursed fiercely:
